title: How this fork is maintained: automated pipeline, your testing is the real verification
author: robertpopa22
body_snippet:
This fork is maintained differently from most projects, and after fair criticism in #143 we want that difference stated plainly rather than discovered through frustration.

## How this fork is maintained

**Fixes are developed and verified by an automated pipeline.** Issue triage, root-cause analysis, the fix itself, and verification against the automated test suite (currently 6,400+ tests, full run on every change) are done by AI agents, with adversarial cross-review between independent mod...
